note: Modern campground at Iowa's oldest state park, in the Maquoketa River valley; wooded loops on the ridge above the south end of Backbone Lake, with a beach, boat rentals and the CCC-era lodge nearby. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 98 sites (47 electric 30/50-amp, 39 non-electric, 10 tent, 2 youth group), 50-amp, showers/flush toilets/dump (off for the season from Oct 29, 2026), 100% reservable on ReserveAmerica to 10 pm day of arrival. Fees left as recorded (DNR 2026 sheet). Manual season left alone (RA agrees: South Lake open year round). Pin ~215 m from the site centroid (fine). Not waterfront confirmed: no RA site carries a Proximity to Water tag, and the nearest pads (17-20) sit ~120 m from Backbone Lake through continuous forest on the slope.
